name: RadioGroup
purpose: Radio buttons let users pick exactly one option from a small, visible set (2–6). RadioGroup provides the required fieldset/legend grouping; Radio is the individual option.

props.name: legend
props.description: The question the group answers. Rendered as <legend>.

props.name: options
props.type: Array<{ value: string; label: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }>
props.description: Options shortcut. On web you may pass <Radio> children instead.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout. Horizontal wraps on narrow screens.

states.name: selected
states.description: Brand ring with filled center dot.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Danger borders and group error message.

keyboard.action: Move focus into the group (to the selected option, or the first).

screenReader: Legend is announced when entering the group.
Each option announces '<label>, radio button, n of m, selected/not selected'.
accessibility.focus: Focus ring on the circle. The group is a single tab stop.
accessibility.touchTarget: Hit area 32px (44px on touch) plus the label.

do: Use when all options should be visible and there are 2–6 of them.
Pre-select a sensible default when one exists.
dont: Don't use for more than ~6 options — use Select.
Don't use a single radio button; use Checkbox.
Don't trigger navigation or actions on change.

related.name: Tabs
related.reason: Switching views rather than choosing a value.

example.web:
<RadioGroup
  legend="Match format"
  defaultValue="bo3"
  options={[
    { value: 'bo1', label: 'Best of 1' },
    { value: 'bo3', label: 'Best of 3' },
    { value: 'bo5', label: 'Best of 5' },
  ]}
/>
